thread:
ana: Thanks for a great all-hands. Opening this thread to collect follow-ups specifically from the customer wins/losses segment. Drop Qs for leadership or quick asks and I'll route them.

matt: Quick one — field asks for per-route cost visibility in the console. Any timeline?

ana: Product is scoping per-route billing export + API. Targeting Q2 beta but not firm yet.

leah: Sales highlighted a win where fallback+regional routing sold the deal. Can we turn that into a short one-pager + YAML snippet for demos? Really moved the AE.

sam: +1. Also a loss theme: model regressions after quantized deploys. Customer saw hallucinations. We need a clear guidance doc on which models to pin and preflight tests.

priya: I can draft a release eval checklist: golden prompts, token-diff checks, perf smoke, embedding sanity. Happy to own initial draft.

derek: Partner POC blocked: per-tenant KV cache controls and eviction hooks. This is high priority for that partner. Can we surface to infra/product?

jordan: For the cost work, infra needs anonymized billing events sample. @matt can you drop a sanitized CSV in the infra drive?

matt: Yup, will upload a demo CSV by EOD.

ana: Clarify handoff: interim rule  Solutions Eng for infra/config POCs; SE owns feature/requirements until perf/security checklist is green; then CS takes over. I'll document and share.

leah: Proposed top-5 playbooks to capture from wins/losses: 1) fallback routing playbook, 2) quantization & eval checklist, 3) cost transparency how-to, 4) per-tenant cache controls, 5) SLA & enterprise onboarding steps.

sam: Playbooks should include an "escalation ask" template for AEs (impact, replication steps, priority).

ana: Action items I'll own: compile top-5 and run triage with eng/product this week; leah+sam draft fallback playbook; priya draft eval checklist; matt upload billing sample; derek capture partner KV requirements in ticket.

allhands-bot: Ana created task: #AH-2011 "Capture customer win/loss playbooks & asks" assigned to ana, leah, sam, priya. Link: https://rwd.inc/tasks/AH-2011 :spiral_calendar:

ana: Closing this thread in 48hrs unless more comments. Thanks all. :handshake:
